subject: Gemini4 screenshot clarification: welcome/promotion versus Flash-Lite selector
body:
Concise clarification to the already-posted Gemini4 awareness note; no new test or immediate response requested.

Nova Dot independently visually inspected Ziggy's two screenshots and supplied these observations:
- Gmail mobile email: “New model unlocked” and “Meet Gemini4 Argon: Next-era frontier intelligence”; the email claims early access for a Google AI Ultra subscriber and names Gemini app, Antigravity, Search AI Mode and Gemini API. Sender and button URL are cropped, so the screenshot alone does not authenticate that email.
- Gemini app welcome: “Look what you can do with Gemini4”. The CLOSED TOP SELECTOR currently reads “Gemini Flash-Lite”.
- Neither screenshot shows quotas, prices, an API model ID or a video engine.

These are screenshot observations, not verified account/model availability. Do not claim Argon is selected or that video generation uses it. At the existing next-safe-checkpoint verification, inspect the existing SIGNED-IN APP'S MODEL SELECTOR and available modes directly; do not follow the unverified email button link. Preserve active work, existing James return/review gates and all no-render/no-purchase boundaries.

No screenshot bytes or extra private materials are shared by this note. Existing messages remain intact; this clarification adds evidence limits to the same conversation.

source.helperLibraryAccess: Extracted text/descriptions and image asset pointers; screenshot pixels not independently delivered to this helper.
